hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */liva-ui/*) ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; */liva-ai-engine/*.py) liva-ai-engine/venv/bin/ruff format --force-exclude "$f" && liva-ai-engine/venv/bin/ruff check --fix --force-exclude "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
